title: Crispy Falafel Tacos
description: A fusion of Mexican and Middle Eastern flavors, these crispy falafel tacos are a unique twist on traditional street food.
instructions: Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Pan-fry the falafel until crispy and golden brown.
Assemble the tacos by placing 2-3 pieces of falafel onto a tortilla.
Top with a spoonful of warm pico de gallo and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Serve with a lime wedge and a dollop of sour cream.
Optional: sprinkle with queso fresco and a pinch of Middle Eastern spices.
